evidence: The paper uses random forest regressors for predicting post-FMT taxon abundances but explicitly employs SHAP (Shapley additive explanations) values rather than impurity-based importance for feature interpretation: "For these well-predicted taxa, we calculated feature contribution using Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) values." No mention of Gini, MDI, variance importance, permutation importance p-values, or other impurity measures appears in the text.
